message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the most common tools and platforms you can use to book flights—whether you’re searching online, using an app, or integrating flight data into your own system.

| Category | Tool / Service | What it offers |
|----------|----------------|----------------|
| **Web & Mobile Booking Sites** | **Google Flights** | Fast search, price alerts, flexible date grids. |
| | **Skyscanner** | Multi‑carrier comparison, “Everywhere” search, price alerts. |
| | **Kayak** | Aggregates many carriers, price forecasts, bundle options. |
| | **Expedia** | Flights + hotels + car rentals, loyalty points. |
| | **Momondo** | Deep‑search across low‑cost carriers, price history. |
| | **Priceline** | “Name Your Own Price” and Express Deals. |
| | **Orbitz** | Similar to Expedia, often bundled with hotels. |
| | **CheapOair** | Focus on discounted fares, promo codes. |
| | **Hopper** | Predictive pricing, mobile‑first experience. |
| | **Trip.com** | Strong presence in Asia, multi‑currency support. |
| | **Travelocity** | Bundles, price match guarantee. |
| | **Booking.com Flights** | Integrated with hotel booking, loyalty program. |
| | **Airbnb Experiences** | Occasionally offers flight + experience packages. |
| **Mobile Apps** | **Google Flights App** | Same features as web, push alerts. |
| | **Skyscanner App** | Price alerts, “Explore” feature. |
| | **Kayak App** | Alerts, price predictions, trip planner. |
| | **Hopper App** | Predictive alerts, “Book Now” button. |
| | **Expedia App** | Bundle deals, loyalty points. |
| | **TripIt** | Organizes itineraries, not a booking tool but useful post‑booking. |
| **API & SDKs (for developers)** | **Skyscanner API** | Flight search, pricing, and booking integration. |
| | **Amadeus Self‑Service APIs** | Flights, hotels, car rentals, travel commerce. |
| | **Kiwi.com API** | Multi‑city, multi‑carrier itineraries, “Nomad” search. |
| | **Travelport API** | Global distribution system (GDS) access. |
| | **Sabre API** | GDS, flight inventory, booking. |
| | **OpenSky API** | Real‑time flight data (not booking). |
| | **FlightAware API** | Tracking, not booking. |
| | **Google Flights API** (unofficial) | Limited access, mainly for research. |
| **Travel Agencies & Aggregators** | **Travel agencies** (e.g., Thomas Cook, TUI) | Personalized service, corporate bookings. |
| | **Online travel agencies (OTAs)** | Same as above but fully online. |
| | **Corporate booking platforms** (e.g., Concur, SAP Concur) | Expense management + flight booking. |
| **Specialty & Low‑Cost Carriers** | **Ryanair, EasyJet, Southwest, JetBlue, AirAsia** | Direct booking on carrier sites for best fares. |
| | **Budget‑focused aggregators** (e.g., Skiplagged, Secret Flying) | Hidden‑city fares, fare hacks. |
| **Other Useful Tools** | **Google Maps** | Check airport locations, transit options. |
| | **FlightRadar24** | Real‑time flight tracking, useful for planning. |
| | **TripAdvisor** | Reviews of airlines, airports. |
| | **Airfarewatchdog** | Alerts for specific routes. |

### How to Choose

1. **Price vs. Convenience** – If you’re hunting the cheapest fare, start with Skyscanner or Google Flights. For bundled travel (flight + hotel + car), Expedia or Booking.com might be better.
2. **Multi‑City & Complex Itineraries** – Kiwi.com or Amadeus APIs give you more flexibility.
3. **Corporate Travel** – Use Concur or SAP Concur for integrated expense reporting.
4. **Mobile‑First** – Hopper or Google Flights app for on‑the‑go alerts.
5. **Developer Integration** – Skyscanner, Amadeus, or Travelport APIs provide robust flight data and booking capabilities.

Feel free to let me know if you need deeper details on any particular platform or how to integrate a specific API!
